name: lmty
description: AI skills for company and market research: research any company, track how your market and competitors are moving, prepare for competitive deals, and see what people say about you in public. Open source. Connect LMTY for public company profiles, your tracked competitors, and market history.

interface.longDescription: Research any company, follow your competitors, and see what people say in public, from inside your AI conversations. LMTY's public profiles cover companies, products, and people, with sources and dates behind every finding. Connect your LMTY account to add your tracked competitors, market history, and social listening. Use it to prepare for a meeting or a competitive deal, check a claim, review your positioning or pricing, see how a competitor's change is landing, or catch up on your market. It's read-only: it reads LMTY data and changes nothing.
defaultPrompt: What does Northwind do? I have a call with them in an hour.
Build a battlecard for us against our main competitor.
What are people saying about us and our competitors this week?
